_comment: Session 44 FIX C. THE single source both consumers read: S41MixamoClipApplier sets S32AnimatorSpeedScaler.referenceSpeedMps from authoredSpeedMps, and tools/run_trial.py derives the SFM speed multiplier from targetSpeedMps. Two different quantities -- conflating them into one constant is what caused the slide.
_authored: MEASURED from AnimationClip.averageSpeed (ground plane), never hand-edited. Regenerate with AutoTrial/Session 44/Refresh clip_speeds.json after any asset re-export; it preserves targetSpeedMps.
_refSource: Session 45: averageSpeed is NET displacement over duration, so it only measures walking pace when the root travels monotonically. net/path ratio per clip decides; below 0.7 the root reverses and averageSpeed understates the pace. Pacing_And_Talking_On_A_Phone measured 0.144 -- it paces back and forth, outbound and return cancel -- so its reference is the median instantaneous speed over moving frames instead.
_target: DESIGN CHOICE, hand-set. null means 'no override, use the pipeline default'. 0 means the character should not travel at all.
_inPlace: true = the clip carries no root translation, so authoredSpeedMps could not be measured and animation scaling is meaningless for it.
